mapper.select: SELECT ods.order_detail_id as orderDetailId, usr.user_id as userId, usr.user_name as userName, ods.order_number as orderNumber, ods.order_branch_number as orderBranchNumber, ods.book_id as bookId, bks.book_title as bookTitle, ods.order_price as orderPrice, ods.book_count as bookCount, ods.order_date as orderDate FROM order_details as ods JOIN books as bks ON ods.book_id = bks.book_id JOIN users as usr ON ods.user_id = usr.user_id WHERE ods.user_id = #{id} ORDER BY ods.order_number desc, ods.order_branch_number asc
